title: Find the full names of members who both (1) attended at least one 'Meeting'
question: Find the full names of members who both (1) attended at least one 'Meeting' event in 2020 and (2) incurred at least one expense greater than $50 (on any event).

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036"
FROM member AS m
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS ev ON a."XCL_001" = ev."XCL_010"
    WHERE ev."XCL_013" = 'Meeting'
      AND SUBSTRING(ev."XCL_012", 1, 4) = '2020'
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT e."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e."XCL_020" > 50
)
